attack.reasoning: The updates identify a recent configuration update as the likely cause of the network disruption, but do not establish who made it or whether hostile action was involved. The available evidence is not enough to rule an attack in or out.

findings.claim: The incident affected GCVE Stretched Cluster customers, with inter-site communication failures and connectivity issues across multiple regions.
The provider reported inter-zone communication failures and BGP session flapping; connectivity was lost between affected zones and the witness appliance.
The provider said a recent configuration update was the likely cause of the inter-zone network disruption.
A remediation rollout was in progress, and the provider identified northamerica-northeast2 as unaffected.
The incident status changed to AVAILABLE at 2026-07-15T05:34:26Z; the resolved update provides no further details because its text is withheld.
Loss of connectivity to the witness appliance prevented safe synchronization between affected cluster zones, contributing to isolation of VMs and possible loss of writable data.

timeline.event: The incident began, according to the stated start time of 10:00 PDT.
The provider publicly reported the disruption, including connectivity issues and inter-site communication failures.
The provider reported a preliminary finding of an underlying network connectivity issue linking zones within a stretched cluster.
The provider reported BGP session flapping, loss of connectivity to the witness appliance, and resulting synchronization and VM-isolation risks.
The provider identified a recent configuration update as the likely cause and said remediation was underway.
The provider said a remediation rollout was in progress and noted that northamerica-northeast2 was not affected.
The incident status changed to AVAILABLE; the resolved update contains no explanatory text.

root_cause.claim: The provider identified a recent configuration update as the likely cause of the inter-zone network disruption. The precise configuration change and how it caused the reported BGP flapping and witness-appliance disconnection are not established by the published updates.

contributing_factors.claim: The witness appliance became unreachable, leaving cluster zones unable to safely synchronize state and exposing affected VMs to isolation and possible loss of writable data.
The issue was not universal across the reported footprint: the provider said northamerica-northeast2 was unaffected.

open_questions.question: What exact configuration change was made, and how did it produce the BGP flapping and loss of connectivity to the witness appliance?
open_questions.why_open: The provider called a recent configuration update the likely cause but did not specify the change or its technical mechanism.

open_questions.question: Was any deliberate hostile action involved?
open_questions.why_open: The updates point to a likely configuration-related cause but do not identify who initiated the change or establish whether hostile action was involved.

open_questions.question: What remediation restored service, and when did connectivity recover relative to the AVAILABLE status?
open_questions.why_open: The provider reported that a remediation rollout was underway, but the resolved update contains no explanatory text or recovery details.
